name: Llandaff Fields Play Area
description: Cardiff Council play area at Llandaff Fields, Riverside, Cardiff, with separate toddler and junior areas on the council's 2020 list. A 2021 refurbishment added three large slides, climbing nets and ropes, sphere stepping stones and a raised embankment play feature.
